content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MSSV Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MSSV Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Faculty positions at Mahapurusha Srimanta Sankaradeva Viswavidyalaya is 03 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Faculty posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 19 vacancies for Faculty positions in the Four-Year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP) at MSSV.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for Assistant Professor posts generally includes a Postgraduate degree in the relevant discipline with a minimum of 55% marks, along with B.Ed. and NET/SET or Ph.D.

faq.question: Q5. Does MSSV offer a specific salary for these faculty positions?
faq.answer: The salary for these faculty positions will be as per applicable MSSV norms or as decided by the University from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the official website of Mahapurusha Srimanta Sankaradeva Viswavidyalaya?
faq.answer: The official website of Mahapurusha Srimanta Sankaradeva Viswavidyalaya is www.mssv.ac.in.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is MSSV/R/147/2026/ADV/001.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Faculty positions will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications for this recruitment are to be submitted via email only.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, proof of date of birth, and caste certificate (where applicable).
